_about: Transit under construction (engine/construction.py). Lines are drawn from OpenStreetMap ways whose name matches 'match' (fetched by engine/fetch_construction.py). Stations are placed at 'at' [lon, lat], snapped to the line. Only facts the owner has published go in 'opens'. Checked October 31, 2026: BART Silicon Valley Phase II is under way (the tunnel launch structure at Newhall Yard) but has no track in OpenStreetMap yet, so it's left off until it does; The Portal (Caltrain's downtown extension to the Salesforce Transit Center) is funded but not yet being built.

lines.name: Eastridge to BART Regional Connector
lines.about: Extends VTA's Orange Line light rail from Alum Rock Transit Center to Eastridge Transit Center in East San Jose, on a guideway above the middle of Capitol Expressway, with a station at Story Road. Building began in May 2024.
